page.overview:
Who is Bruno Adonidas?

Bruno Adonidas (Greek: Μπρούνο Άδωνιδας) is a fictional Greek smuggler and intelligence operative who appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

After a vicious double-cross upon the Mediterranean Sea, Bruno was left to drown. Rescued by a small patrol boat from Cyprus on the lookout for Syrian refugees, Bruno made contact with the authorities and began the slow process of infiltrating and destroying his rival's smuggling ring. Notable for his alcoholism, he has skills in smuggling, piloting and hand-to-hand combat, and is multi-lingual, speaking Greek, English, Turkish and Serbian. The character offers a buff which reduces the Alliance War token regeneration duration and provides a +10 bonus to total offence using sleeve guns and +15 bonus to total offence using incendiary chemicals. He is an "uncommon agent" (green) and can be levelled to level 15.
